title.narrative: IOM. Assistance and Protection of Unaccompanied and Separated Children in Morocco. Phase III. 2024-2025

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the third phase of the UASC project is to continue providing direct protection and assistance to unaccompanied and separated children through partner civil society organisations in three different Moroccan regions - and over a three year period with a budget of DKK 10 million - and to continue supporting the Government of Morocco in collaboration with UNICEF with the reinforcement of national referral mechanisms is specific Moroccan regions.
Trainings on child protection, countertrafficking and smuggling as well as strengthening national referral mechanisms will be ongoing in collaboration with UNICEF and UNHCR and the National Commission to Combat Trafficking in Persons of the Ministry of Justice. Joint United Nations advocacy will continue in the third phase.
